title: Large language model assistance for report-based carotid plaque AHA classification: a multi-reader study
authors_text: Mengfei Wang*, Yixiao Tang*, Yulu Yang, Yifan Tu, Zhongzheng Cao, Runjianya Ling, Kaiyue Sun, Jian Ma, Zhicheng Zhang, Ruipeng Zhang#, Xiaoer Wei#, Dan Wang#, Yuehua Li#. * Co-first authors. # Corresponding authors.
abstract: A retrospective multicenter study of 433 patients evaluated 10 large language models and a four-radiologist reader study for modified AHA classification of carotid plaques from free-text MRI reports. LLM assistance improved agreement with an expert-consensus, report-text reference standard, and criteria-guided prompting supported effective use of a lightweight 8B model.
